reviews.text: Amazing service from an amazing team!!! My pets love them as do I! They provide great dog walking services. I originally found them from a friend recommendation. Thank you, Paw Time for all you do!

Literally, the best experience of my life. My dog passed away after 10 years with our family and they dug the grave and buried my dog, and we were in the loop about everything there and they are the best human beings in the world—and they brought flowers a few days later for my dog’s grave.

Paw Time Favorite has been amazing! With my busy schedule, I never want my buddy Bear wondering when his next walk is, and he thrives on routine. Their reliable, caring dog walking and pet sitting service has been a huge help. I know Bear is in great hands when I can’t be there. Highly recommend Paw Time Favorite for dependable, loving pet care!

Highly recommend Paw Time Favorite! This is a standout company of professional, reliable pet sitters. Their dog walking services are reasonably priced and flexible and they offer memberships too, which is super convenient. I especially love the detailed report cards with pictures from every visit!

Absolutely love the dog walking membership! Signed up after having a baby and was unable to manage walking 3 dogs but still wanted to have them get the care and enrichment time with their walks. Love getting the report card updates with the pictures of my pups enjoying their time out. So happy I found such a trustworthy team to take care of my crew 😊
Very happy to use Paw Time, they did a great job with our furry love and it’s so appreciated!
The staff at Paw Time are great people. They care about your fur babies and go above and beyond for their clients. Give them a try. You'll not be disappointed :)
Very attentive and caring people. Our dog loves when he has time with them. Very professional. Highly recommend.
Paw Time was great with caring for our pup Leo during our time away!!  They sent pics and detailed updates every visit!
Love the daily reports and pictures!!

I had an excellent experience with Pawtime Favorite Petsitting! They provide excellent pet care in the Southtown area of San Antonio and were incredibly reliable while we were away. Communication was amazing, and their report cards were very detailed and thorough, which gave us so much peace of mind while on vacation.

My baby Ezzo had just gotten fixed before our trip, so I was especially nervous about leaving him. Pawtime Favorite Petsitting did an amazing job administering his medication and keeping a close eye on his recovery. They made sure his surgical area and testicular sac were not becoming inflamed and kept us informed of anything they noticed. I really appreciated how attentive and careful they were with him during such an important recovery period.

If they noticed anything abnormal or anything outside of what I had included in my pets’ charts, they were always courteous about informing us right away. It was such a relief knowing all of my pets were in such good hands while we were away.

I will absolutely be using Pawtime Favorite Petsitting again. Highly recommend them to anyone looking for reliable, caring, and communicative pet sitters in San Antonio!

Pawtime personnel took care of my dog when i went out on a work trip. They were in constant communication with me and provided updates. I was able to focus on work knowing that my dog was taken care of. Thank you and hope we are able to do business again!!!

The actual sitter that came to my house did a great job,  but I did have issues with the company itself. I scheduled their services in advance, did a consultation, and confirmed their services, so everything should have been set and understood by both parties, but the company called while I was overseas trying to cancel their service because of a misunderstanding on their end. They never told me that a daily visit was required, which I understand for liability reasons but this was never discussed, then threatened to cancel on me if I did not add daily services halfway through my trip or if I tried to have friends or family come check my animals between their services. Eventually, they agreed to continue the schedule that we agreed to, but I found this incredibly unprofessional and would never go back to them again after this. I also know of other complaints similar to this, but they have not been shared, so please keep this in mind when scheduling with this company. They also got upset when I contacted the sitter to give them a tip directly rather than through their company. Again, the actual sitters are great, reliable people, so nothing against them, but I felt like this experience needed to be shared for anyone else planning to use them for long trips.

*Edited to add after reply from company:

Unfortunately there are some inaccuracies in the company's response to my initial review, such as stating that they tried to cancel early upon collecting a down payment and allowing 72 hours between visits. I do have credit card and phone logs that prove this inaccuracy, so I'm very disappointed that the company would be dishonest in this way. I also made it very clear at the consultation that I would be away and that I had bulk feeders, water, and an automatic litter box to handle the every-two-day visits. Again, others have had different experiences, but I would want to know the good and the bad when considering someone to take care of my cats in the future.
Excellent service! We were staying at the Hyatt Hill Country and they came to us to spend time with our dog while we enjoyed the lazy river and pool. Highly recommend them. They are wonderful.

Great experience. We were staying at the Hyatt Hill Country Resort and brought our dog. They came out at the last minute to give us a 4 hour break and we couldn’t have been more happy with their care and service. Highly recommend!

Super pleased with my experience with Paw Time Favorite Pet Sitting! They were communicative, thorough, and kind. I did not have to worry about my cats while I was away, and getting updates with pictures was fantastic. They were incredibly accommodating making sure my cats got to keep their routine. I would recommend their services and would happily book with them again!

Paw Time Favorite Pet Sitting was able to provide very detailed and dedicated care to my household which has multiple dogs, cats, and reptiles. They are simply the best in terms of their ability to care for your animals exactly how they would be cared for if you were home. Their sitters are super considerate and getting the visit reports really makes it possible to feel comfortable and relaxed about being away from your pets!

Paw Time provided a great service during a time I was recovering from surgery and short of family to help give my energetic little dog a proper walk. All of the ladies I dealt with on the phone and in person were pleasant , helpful and always on time.

Had such a fantastic experience with Paw Time!! I had in home pet sitting done for my 3 dogs and they did such a stellar job and put my mind at ease while I was out of town. Very detailed with the report cards sent for each visit with pictures and step by step of the visit. Highly recommend their services and will be using them for all future pet sitting!

This really is a tremendous company. They take great care in communicating with you and performing a pre-visit inspection. They ensure that everything is taken care of according to your instructions. They communicate very well with each visit via emails and send pictures. They also perform ancillary tasks like bringing packages inside and cleaning up any accidents that your pet may have had. They're very responsive and accommodate any special requests. Each person they send is professional and performs the tasks that you ask. Highly recommend this company. Very professional.
Our dogs love the Paw Time walkers. Such a great help to me when I travel. Love knowing they are getting outside and they always follow up with pictures and updates on their potty experience.

Paw time favorite exceeded my expectations for pets care. I used to ask friends and neighbors but they would cancel last minute which would put me in a tight position. When I found this company, they were throughly professional, they sent report cards with pictures, and really showed the bond with my dogs. I found them online as they have many great reviews and I always recommend them to all my coworkers. I use them for dog walking and pet sitting when I have to work long hours or leave out of town. Definitely recommend without hesitation! 🐾😍🐾

Paw Time Favorite has always been my go to pet sitter! I’ve used their services for many years now and they are always great! They leave report cards for me to know what’s going on and the team always gives quality care. I highly recommend them if you’re needing pet sitting in San Antonio!

We had a great experience using Paw Time! Our pets were well taken care of and loved on while we were away from home. They are very detail oriented and did not miss anything requested. They went above and beyond to provide great pet care.

I cannot say enough wonderful things about this hard-working small business. The service they provide is incredible! They truly go above and beyond, and it is so clear that they genuinely care about the pets in their care. I absolutely love receiving photos from every visit along with the report card, it is very comforting to be kept in the loop with such detail.

What really stands out to me is how they tailor each visit to the unique needs of every pet. The service is thoughtful, thorough, and done right. I feel so thankful to have found them because they are trustworthy, respectful of instructions, and incredibly reliable. Most importantly, my dogs are genuinely enjoying their visits, which means so much to me! I highly recommend Paw Time Favorite Pet Sitting! 🐾💛

I’ve had a wonderful experience with Paw Time Favorite Pet Sitting & Dog Walking! Their team is professional, reliable, and genuinely cares about every pet they look after. They provide excellent communication with updates and photos, which gives great peace of mind while I’m away. If you’re looking for trustworthy pet sitters or dog walkers, I highly recommend Paw Time Favorite Pet Sitting & Dog Walking!!!

Paw Time Favorite Pet Sitting & Dog Walking provides dependable, professional, and loving pet care. Their team is trustworthy, communicative, and treats every pet like their own. I always receive helpful updates and photos, which gives me peace of mind while I’m away.

Whether you need reliable dog walking, in-home pet sitting, vacation pet care, or daily visits, Paw Time is an excellent choice. They are attentive to each pet’s routine, safety, and individual needs. I highly recommend Paw Time Favorite Pet Sitting & Dog Walking to anyone looking for a caring and reliable pet sitter or dog walker!

Paw time is great and did a good job taking care of my pets while I was away for a weekend! They even did a good job with my reptile that needed care, even though I know that’s an unusual case for them!
Pawtime crew was amazing with our babies. We have one dog who is scared of everyone. They were so sweet with him and took time until he was ready. I will definitely use them again.
Margo loves her morning walks. The reports we receive are very detailed.

Amazing team of caring individuals who treat my pets with the same love I have for them.  Detailed reports and pictures calm my anxiety when I have to travel for work.  I highly recommend them for your pet sitting needs.

Paw Time is above-and-beyond with their knowledge, care, and attention to both pets and home while we are away. They are highly attentive to the details and specialness of each pet. We have 2 dogs and 3 cats, 1 cat with special diet and meds (and the other 2 would eat all his food if given the chance!). They attended to our instructions perfectly. And the team is fully dedicated to client satisfaction. They have earned our highest recommendation.
HIGHLY recommend Paw Time.   Amazing owners and team. My pups love them!!!

The Paw Time team was highly organized frrom the first to last encounter.. Tasks we wanted to occur were clearly defined and documented at each visit. The visit summaries and pictures helped us feel confident that care was provided aas we agreed.

Paw Time Favorite Pet Sitting did an amazing job caring for our three pups while we were gone for 7 days! They came 4 times per day and went above and beyond every single visit. We received detailed visit reports with pictures, which gave us so much peace of mind while we were away.

They gave our dog medications, made sure food and water were taken care of, and gave all three of our pups lots of love and attention. They even alerted us to an AC issue at our house and knocked down a wasp nest. That kind of care and attention truly means so much.

We are extremely grateful for their professionalism, communication, and genuine love for our dogs. Highly recommend Paw Time Favorite Pet Sitting!

Amazing experience!
I had to go out of town for 2 days and I was very nervous of leaving my babies. I never go on family vacations because of that. They gave me so much peace in the experience.

I've had a great experience with Paw Time Favorites. They're reliable, professional, and you can tell they genuinely care about the pets they work with. Whether it's dog walking, pet sitting, or just checking in on your furry family members, they go the extra mile to make sure everything is taken care of. It's hard to find people you can trust with your pets, and I wouldn't hesitate to recommend them to anyone looking for dependable pet care.
Great dog walking service! I was referred to them by our veterinarian.

I’m so happy with the service provided! My dogs were happy, calm, and not stressed at all when I got home, which says everything. It’s clear they were well cared for. Professional, reliable, and I would absolutely recommend and use again when I travel!
